title: Glowing bell
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="100" height="100">
  <!-- Glow aura -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="48" r="38" fill="#FFD54A" opacity="0.12"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="48" r="30" fill="#FFD54A" opacity="0.15"/>
  
  <!-- Bell body -->
  <path d="M50 14 C50 14, 28 30, 28 52 L28 58 L72 58 L72 52 C72 30, 50 14, 50 14 Z" fill="#FFC107"/>
  
  <!-- Bell highlight (lighter shade for edge) -->
  <path d="M50 18 C50 18, 33 32, 33 52 L33 54 L38 54 L38 52 C38 35, 50 22, 50 22 Z" fill="#FFE082"/>
  
  <!-- Bell rim -->
  <rect x="24" y="56" width="52" height="7" rx="3.5" fill="#FFA000"/>
  
  <!-- Bell rim highlight -->
  <rect x="24" y="56" width="52" height="3" rx="1.5" fill="#FFCA28"/>
  
  <!-- Clapper -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="70" r="7" fill="#FF8F00"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="70" r="4" fill="#FFCA28"/>
  
  <!-- Clapper shine -->
  <circle cx="48" cy="68" r="1.5" fill="#FFF8E1"/>
  
  <!-- Bell top loop/handle -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="12" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#FFA000" stroke-width="4"/>
  
  <!-- Glow rays -->
  <line x1="50" y1="2" x2="50" y2="7" stroke="#FFE082" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="72" y1="8" x2="68" y2="12" stroke="#FFE082" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="28" y1="8" x2="32" y2="12" stroke="#FFE082" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="80" y1="26" x2="75" y2="27" stroke="#FFE082" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="20" y1="26" x2="25" y2="27" stroke="#FFE082" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  
  <!-- Sparkles -->
  <g fill="#FFE082">
    <polygon points="84,44 86,48 90,50 86,52 84,56 82,52 78,50 82,48"/>
    <polygon points="16,60 17.5,63 20.5,64 17.5,65 16,68 14.5,65 11.5,64 14.5,63"/>
    <polygon points="78,68 79,70 81,71 79,72 78,74 77,72 75,71 77,70"/>
  </g>
  
  <!-- Bell shine -->
  <ellipse cx="42" cy="36" rx="4" ry="10" fill="#FFF8E1" opacity="0.5" transform="rotate(-15 42 36)"/>
</svg>
